annotations.text:
Sample content.
The five storefronts shown are the demo fixtures seeded in index.html — swap in real vendors before this goes to print.
[YOUR CONTACT NUMBER] is the one thing left blank — the app has no vendor self-signup, so an admin creates the store. Put the number or Messenger handle you want sellers to reach.

Headline is the question residents actually ask in the group chat.
English alternate if you prefer: “Your neighbors are cooking.” / “Tower 2. Ten minutes. ₱60.”
QR is the verified code from index.html — it resolves to the live app.
